name: Magus Lightning Conduit
body:
Some magi learn the power of conducting lightning through the metal of their weapons and armor.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

A lightning conduit gains proficiency with all armor and shields (except tower shields). This modifies a magus’s proficiencies.

Conductive Casting (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, when casting spells with the electricity descriptor, the lightning conduit does not suffer from any arcane spell failure from metal armor or shields. All other spells suffer from the spell failure chance as normal, if applicable. This ability replaces medium armor and heavy armor.

Electrical Substitution (Ex)

At 3rd level, a lightning conduit gains the benefit of the Elemental Spell feat, though they may only change the damage type to electricity. The lightning conduit can use a number of points from their arcane pool equal to the spell’s original level to apply this to a spell being cast as a swift action. At 15th level, preparing a spell with this metamagic feat to change the damage type to electricity does not use a slot 1 higher than normal. This ability replaces the magus arcana gained at 3rd and 15th levels.
